owns: SR-level Spare Need demand and contributor relations
Spare Request local identity, allocations and submission evidence
RMA obligation identity, target assignment, inbound/return-unit relationships
Spare Part Unit physical inventory identity and Stock eligibility projection
reviewed maintenance physical consequences consumed from Task review
submission logistics intent and actual logistics/custody events
Fault Tag membership and return-attempt lifecycle
warehouse receipt/final disposition and resend/replacement/correction history
operational Device Part Unit identity/fault evidence under Device Reference context
does_not_own: Service Request lifecycle or Customer identity
Device Reference or Network Element identity
registered Installed Component master identity/history under a Network Element
Contact or Dispatch Location master identity
crossing_rules: HLD-06 supplies reviewed Task outcomes/physical-consequence trigger context; Inventory never writes Task outcome state.
HLD-10 may propose Inventory transitions from communication evidence; acceptance still invokes Inventory commands.
HLD-03 supplies Contact and Dispatch Location identities; immutable submission/pickup snapshots materialize only represented historical values.

HLD-09 supplies Device Reference/Network Element context and, where registered, Installed Component master/history; Inventory may link a Device Part Unit to that Installed Component through an explicit resolution relation but never replaces either identity.
No Inventory relationship mutation may cascade-delete independently surviving tickets, Tasks, Contacts, locations, communications or exported artifacts.

physical_boundary.device_part_unit: operational service/fault component under Device Reference context; may remain unregistered and is distinct from both Inventory Spare Part Unit and an optional HLD-09 Installed Component resolution
physical_boundary.spare_part_unit: actual inventory/fulfillment physical unit with immutable SOMA identity
physical_boundary.rma: two-sided provider authorization/return obligation; not the physical unit
physical_boundary.stock: derived eligibility view over Spare Part Units; not a duplicate unit table
